review_scope: Each of these twelve extracted images was viewed individually. This is framing triage, not box approval or proof of source independence.

decisions.reason: Visible pedestrian and delivery van; no forklift. Camera origin and relation to other frames remain unknown.
One complete pedestrian and a second person clipped at right. Low resolution; original scene provenance needed.
Partial forklift wheel and chassis fill frame; unsuitable for distant-camera expansion.
Close forklift photo rotated sideways; not distant CCTV.
Sideways transformed frame with black borders and washed-out contrast; not the desired camera framing.
Ground-level monochrome construction photograph with transformed black borders; not elevated CCTV.
Forklift with visible operator and apparent person at rear. Actual camera provenance and the rear person's category need resolution before approval.
Training/demo gathering around forklift and cargo, viewed at ground level. Original remains preserved.
Cargo dominates close portrait photograph; no distant elevated-camera view.
Low-resolution ground-level forklift photograph, not elevated CCTV.
Close inventory/product photograph with overlaid identification text.
Close rear forklift photograph; operator presence cannot be inferred from the hidden cabin.
